assumptions.model: one item per family, one seed; discordant family favours treatment with prob 0.5+delta/(2d)
assumptions.discordance_grid_source: declared sensitivity grid; E01 historical paired discordance on the 150-word pick test was 29/150 = 0.19 per seed (D174), from a different model pair and panel

conclusion: The attainable primary set is underpowered for a 5-point gain at every discordance >= 0.10; expect an inconclusive interval unless the true gain is much larger.
